statics.受付の判子が、勝手にあなたの手の甲に押された。「保留」。: The reception stamp pressed itself onto the back of your hand. “PENDING.”
statics.琥珀の中の蟻と目が合った。向こうが先に目を逸らした。: You met the eyes of an ant in amber. It looked away first.
statics.固まりかけた床に、誰かの灯りが埋まっている。芯はまだ温かい。少しだけ油を分けても: Someone's lamp is buried in the half-set floor. The wick is still warm. They let you have a little oil.
statics.案内板には、この階がない。13 の数字だけ、上から紙が貼ってある。: The directory doesn't list this floor. Paper is pasted over the number 13.
statics.時計が一度だけ、逆に回った。誰も気づいていない。: The clock ran backward, just once. No one noticed.
statics.百階。数えるのをやめた。: Floor one hundred. You stopped counting.
statics.見て測ってから掘る人で、［場所］と［視線］の札がよく効く。: Looks and measures before digging; [Place] and [Gaze] cards work well.
statics.殴られ慣れた体で遭遇の初めから守り 3 を構え、深夜は［夜］の札が強まって、手番: A body used to taking hits: start each encounter braced with guard 3. Late at night, [Night] cards grow stronger, and a quarter of the guard left at turn's end spills into trust.
statics.暗闇でものを見る目と消えない記憶を持ち、札を続けて打ったときの連鎖がひときわ深く: Eyes that see in the dark and a memory that won't fade: chains from consecutive cards run especially deep (+2).
statics.手がかりを一つ見るたびにそれが記事になって金 3 が入り、［公開情報］の札がよく: Every clue you see becomes a story worth 3 coins; [Public] cards work well.
statics.指先が利いて逃げ足も速く、立ち去りやすさが +20% で、［私的情報］の札がよく: Nimble fingers and quick feet: walking away +20%, and [Private] cards work well.
statics.手当てに慣れていて回復が 1.5 倍になり、体の弱った相手ほど、あなたに心を開き: Used to tending wounds: recovery is 1.5×, and the weaker an opponent's body, the more readily they open up to you.
statics.鉄と火に慣れた手で、［技術］と［身体］の札がよく効き、手番ごとに守りと構えが 1: Hands used to iron and fire: [Tech] and [Body] cards work well, and guard and poise build by 1 each turn.
statics.戦利品を漁った。次の三戦、悪名が先回りして相手は荒れているが、勢いのぶん相手の体: You picked through the Spoils. For the next three encounters, your Notoriety runs ahead of you and opponents arrive riled, but the momentum gives Opponent HP damage +3.
statics.相手の名を奪った。次の三戦、噂を聞いた相手は意志が三割削れた状態で現れる。: You took their name. For the next three encounters, opponents have heard the rumor and arrive with their will already 30% broken.
statics.味方がついた。次の四戦、初めに守り +4・構え +4・相手の信頼 +1。倒れる一: You found an Ally. For the next four encounters, start with guard +4 · poise +4 · Opponent trust +1. They take one fatal blow for you, once.
statics.秘密を握った。次の三戦、相手の予告はいつも本当の姿で見え、手がかりが一つ見えてい: You hold a secret. For the next three encounters, opponents' tells always show their true form, and one clue is visible.
statics.見透かし：予告が本当の姿で見える: Insight: Tells show their true form
statics.深夜と、深い層ほど荒れている: Rougher late at night, and the deeper you go
statics.建物の上のほうはまるごと夜の街になっていて、通りの看板の灯りが、吹き抜けの縦坑の: The upper floors of the building are a whole night city; the glow of street signs blurs on the walls of the open shaft.
statics.階段を下りきると時計が 22 時に戻っていて、紙と埃の匂いのこもったこの階が、上: At the foot of the stairs the clock is back at 22:00, and this floor, thick with the smell of paper and dust, is a much older night than the one above.
statics.時計はまた 22 時を指していて、さらに古い夜の空気は、琥珀のように固まりかけた: The clock reads 22:00 again, and the air of a still older night hangs motionless, half-set like amber.
statics.掟《固まる》 守りが半分残る: Law «Setting» Half of guard carries over
statics.角の食堂だけ明かりがついている。カウンターに客が三人、黙ってコーヒーを飲んでいる: Only the corner canteen has its lights on. Three customers at the counter, drinking coffee in silence.
statics.静かになった。久しぶりの静けさだ。: It's quiet now. Quiet, for the first time in a long while.
statics.エピテットの刻まれた場所に着く: Reach a place inscribed with an epithet
statics.内側のほうが広い：場所に刻まれたエピテットと見せ場が多いほど強い（1 つにつき: Bigger on the inside: stronger the more epithets and spotlights are inscribed on places (×1.25 each)
